verified: Genesis AI itself announced the $500 million Series A and the $3.5 billion valuation, per Wall Street Journal reporting.
unconfirmed: the identities of the investors, the actual dexterity or general-purpose capability of the robot, and any pilot, customer, or shipment figures; the sources also leave out the round's other terms and the robot's timeline to market.

verified: 据《华尔街日报》报道，Genesis AI 表示已完成 5 亿美元 A 轮融资、估值 35 亿美元，公司总部位于巴黎，业务描述为研发面向仓库与家庭的通用灵巧机器人。
unconfirmed: 投资方名单、除金额与估值外的交易条款、资金用途和产品时间表均未公开；“更强灵巧性”“通用”以及“训练灵巧机器人的新方法”目前只是公司说法，没有公开演示、基准测试或客户部署可供独立验证。

titles.en: Genesis AI raises $500M Series A at $3.5B valuation for dexterous robots
titles.zh: 巴黎 Genesis AI 以 35 亿美元估值完成 5 亿美元 A 轮融资
